# Midwestern Doctor

> A Substack publication exposing pharmaceutical industry misconduct, vaccine safety concerns, and forgotten alternative medical therapies.

The Forgotten Side of Medicine is a platform by A Midwestern Doctor that critically examines COVID-19 vaccine safety data, pharmaceutical fraud allegations, and alternative treatment approaches. The site challenges mainstream medical narratives and regulatory agency transparency regarding vaccine adverse events and Big Pharma business practices.

## Key Topics

- COVID-19 vaccines
- Vaccine safety
- Pharmaceutical industry
- FDA/CDC oversight
- Pfizer/Moderna
- Vaccine adverse events
- Alternative medicine
- Neurological injury
- Zeta potential
- Statins
- Hydroxychloroquine
- Medical corruption
- Infant formula
- Bioweapons research
- Healthcare system critique

## COVID-19 Vaccine Safety & Trials

- [What Really Happened Inside the COVID-19 Vaccine Trials?](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-really-happened-inside-the-covid): COVID-19 vaccine trial safety concerns and pharmaceutical misconduct
- [Newly Leaked Data Shows Just How Dangerous the COVID Vaccines Are](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/newly-leaked-data-shows-just-how): COVID vaccine injury data, FDA oversight, and government transparency
- [We Now Have Key Evidence Pfizer Committed Fraud](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/we-now-have-definitive-proof-pfizer): Pfizer vaccine content analysis and pharmaceutical fraud allegations
- [We Now Have Clear Proof the Vaccine is Dangerous and That The CDC Concealed It](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/we-now-have-clear-proof-the-vaccine): CDC V-safe data revealing vaccine adverse events and concealment
- [We Now Have Proof The COVID Vaccines Damage Cognition](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/we-now-have-proof-the-covid-vaccines): COVID vaccine cognitive damage and neurological injury mechanisms
- [Do The COVID Vaccines Affect Your Ability to Think?](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/do-the-covid-vaccines-impair-your): COVID vaccine neurological injuries and cognitive impairment claims
- [Another Investigation Proves There was Systemic Corruption in the COVID-19 Response](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/another-investigation-proves-there): COVID-19 response corruption, vaccine criticism, treatment suppression
- [What Happens to Vaccine Clinical Trial Participants?](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-happens-to-vaccine-clinical): Vaccine trial participant safety and pharmaceutical accountability

## Pharmaceutical Industry & Medical Corruption

- [The Hidden Dangers of Antidepressants and Why They're So Hard To Stop Taking](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/the-hidden-dangers-of-antidepressants): SSRIs/SNRIs dangers, withdrawal effects, and antidepressant dependency
- [What They Don't Tell Us About Heart Disease](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-they-dont-tell-us-about-heart): Statin dangers and cholesterol myth in cardiovascular health
- [What is Causing the Explosion of RSV?](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-is-causing-the-explosion-of): RSV vaccine and Big Pharma's business model in respiratory illness
- [Why Is What We Feed Infants So Unhealthy?](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/why-is-what-we-feed-infants-so-unhealthy): Infant formula dangers and breastfeeding benefits versus industry
- [The Century of Evidence That Vaccines Cause Sudden Infant Deaths](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/a-century-of-evidence-has-accumulated): SIDS/SADS vaccine claims and infant mortality safety concerns

## Alternative Medicine & Therapeutics

- [How to Improve Zeta Potential and Liquid Crystalline Water Inside the Body](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/how-to-improve-zeta-potential-and): Zeta potential optimization and water cure alternative medicine guide
- [What Vaccine Injuries Reveal About the Root Causes of Disease](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-vaccine-injuries-reveal-about): Vaccine injuries, zeta potential, and disease pathophysiology
- [What Caused the L.A. Fires and How Can We Prevent Wildfire Toxicity?](https://www.midwesterndoctor.com/p/what-caused-the-la-fires-and-how-d2b): LA wildfire health effects and alternative medicine toxicity treatments
